patch_description: Replace uniform long anneals with a two-stage basin-selection strategy. Short initial searches explore distinct oriented-ring and hull sign patterns cheaply; only the strongest configurations are reheated and refined with a smaller move scale. This is particularly useful for the nonsmooth Heilbronn objective, where a single long run often commits early to a mediocre set of active near-degenerate triangles. The total iteration budget is also slightly reduced while concentrating refinement on promising basins.
